Dear [Hiring Manager],  

I’ve collaborated with Deepti Mishra on a few projects at Ecomify Inc., primarily around scaling their cloud infrastructure and improving operational efficiency. As a peer in a small startup, we’ve had occasional but meaningful interactions, often centered on technical challenges and team dynamics.  

Deepti’s strength lies in her ability to balance high-level system design with hands-on execution. During our work on migrating Ecomify’s monorepo to Kubernetes, she spearheaded the architecture decisions, which reduced deployment times by 40% and minimized downtime during peak seasons. Her approach to cloud cost optimization was equally impactful—she identified redundant AWS resources, trimming monthly expenses by over $15k without compromising performance.  

One standout moment was her leadership during a critical CI/CD pipeline overhaul. When a critical bug in the pipeline caused delays, Deepti rearchitected the workflow, integrating Terraform for infrastructure-as-code. This not only resolved the immediate issue but also established a maintainable process that’s now part of our standard practice. She’s also a mentor—she guided a junior engineer through debugging a complex database optimization issue, which later became a key component of our analytics dashboard.  

Deepti’s cross-team collaboration skills are central to her identity. She consistently bridges gaps between engineering and product teams, ensuring technical feasibility aligns with business goals. Her work ethic is equally notable: she’s reliable, detail-oriented, and unafraid to tackle ambiguous problems.  

In summary, Deepti is a rare blend of technical rigor and collaborative leadership. I’m confident she’ll add significant value to your team.  

Best regards,  
[Your Name]
